			Grid.FirstPage()

		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Produccion.vwAnaliticaCarreteFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Produccion.vwAnaliticaCarreteFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Produccion.vwAnaliticaCarreteFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	EndCase

&PDFNombre = 'Carreta' + CarreteId.ToString().Trim()
	
	&TipoMaterial = obtenertipoMaterialPorCarrete.Udp(CarreteCarreraId)
	debugger.Call(niveldebug.Informativo, &Pgmname, CarreteCarreraId.ToString() +'|'+ &TipoMaterial)
	Do Case
		Case &TipoMaterial = TipoMaterial.DOW
			CarreteReportMain.Call(CarreteId,0,&PDFNombre)
		Case &TipoMaterial = TipoMaterial.PCR
			CarreteReportMainPCR.Call(CarreteId,0,&PDFNombre)
	EndCase
	
	&Url = &HttpRequest.BaseUrl + &PDFNombre + '.pdf'
	&Window.Url = &Url 
	&Window.Open()
